card.name: Space before a money or percent figure
card.fires_on: The space (or first digit) right before a number in a price, rate or percentage, after words like approximately, only, up to, is, by or less than. It appears in general web text about money, taxes, wages and costs.

modes.label: Space before a percent
modes.description: The gap after a hedge or verb, just before a number that will be followed by percent or %.
modes.example: paid $136MM of performance royalties -- approximately<< >>50 percent of the total revenue.

modes.label: Space before cents or pence
modes.description: The gap before a small price figure in cents or pence.
modes.example: that dollar bill in your pocket today would be worth only<< >>82 cents in today's dollars.

modes.label: Digit starting an amount
modes.description: The first digit of a number being given as a tax or rate.
modes.example: annual tax of 1<<2>> marks and an annual sum for candle grease

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward writing the digits or number that comes next, though the output tokens are not clearly related.
card.plain: It fires just before a number is given for a price, tax rate or percentage.
